summary: Per second on the size you asked for, out of a monthly plan that is also a credit; paid plans include a pool of disk, and only disk beyond it bills.

egress.note: Sending is capped at about 50 Mbit/s per machine.
egress.included: 100 GiB on Free, 1 TiB on Pro, 5 TiB on Builder, 50 TiB on Team

notes: The free plan is one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine that pauses after 30 idle minutes and runs at most 480 minutes at a time; it is not priced here.
Egress is $0.02 per GiB beyond each plan's included allowance.

Paid plans include disk across all machines: 200 GiB on Pro, 1 TiB on Builder and 5 TiB on Team, then $0.08 per GiB-month. The card models each pool as that many GiB held all month (GiB × 730 hours), which matches a pool only when the disk stays allocated all month.
Snapshots and a paused machine's saved memory are free.
NVIDIA L4 GPU machines cost $0.80 per GPU-hour on top of the 11 vCPU / 36 GiB each GPU brings ($0.925 an hour all in), paid plans only; the calculator does not price GPUs.
Sizes are 2 GiB of memory per vCPU: Pro allows 2/4, 4/8 and 8/16, Builder up to 16/32 and Team up to 32/64, with disk up to 200, 500 and 1,024 GiB.
sleeps: An idle machine pauses itself and wakes when its preview link is used; paused time bills storage only. A manual pause does not wake on use.

upkeep.label: Updates not published
upkeep.detail: Machines are kept between runs and you install software with apt. InstaBox does not say who patches a machine you keep.

source.quote: apt manages the machine's own system
